options: She has finished her report yesterday.
She finished her report yesterday.
She finishes her report yesterday.
She has finish her report yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 是具体过去时间，必须用一般过去时 finished。现在完成时不能与 yesterday 连用。

options: I have seen that film last week.
I saw that film last week.
I have saw that film last week.
I see that film last week.
answers: I saw that film last week.
questions.explanation: last week 是具体过去时间，用一般过去时 saw。
questions.evidence: I saw that film last week.

options: They have already left the office.
They already left the office.
They have already leave the office.
They has already left the office.
answers: They have already left the office.
questions.explanation: already 常与现在完成时连用，表示动作已完成，对现在有影响。主语 They 用 have。
questions.evidence: They have already left the office.

options: He has lived here since 2010.
He lived here since 2010.
He has live here since 2010.
He is living here since 2010.
questions.explanation: since 2010 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时 has lived。

options: We have visited the museum two days ago.
We visited the museum two days ago.
We have visit the museum two days ago.
We visit the museum two days ago.
answers: We visited the museum two days ago.
questions.explanation: two days ago 是具体过去时间，用一般过去时 visited。
questions.evidence: We visited the museum two days ago.

options: She has just finished her homework.
She just finished her homework.
She has just finish her homework.
She have just finished her homework.
answers: She has just finished her homework.
questions.explanation: just 常与现在完成时连用，表示刚刚完成。主语 She 用 has。
questions.evidence: She has just finished her homework.

options: I have never been to Japan.
I never went to Japan.
I have never go to Japan.
I never have been to Japan.
answers: I have never been to Japan.
questions.explanation: never 常与现在完成时连用，表示从未有过某种经历。
questions.evidence: I have never been to Japan.

options: They have known each other for ten years.
They knew each other for ten years.
They have know each other for ten years.
They are knowing each other for ten years.
answers: They have known each other for ten years.
questions.explanation: for ten years 表示持续一段时间，用现在完成时 have known。know 是状态动词，一般不用进行时。
questions.evidence: They have known each other for ten years.

title: Learning from Failure: A Simulated Case Study of an Adult Education Centre · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
在英语中，一般过去时表示过去某个具体时间发生的动作或状态，常与明确的时间状语连用，如 in 2022, last week, yesterday。现在完成时表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或者从过去持续到现在的状态，常与 already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for 等连用。注意：现在完成时不能与表示具体过去时间的状语连用。例如：We launched the course in 2022.（正确）We have launched the course in 2022.（错误）

The course ran for eight weeks, and by the end, only five students were still attending.
